main_text.p: Indicibus & textu Chrysostomi, Hieronymi, Cyrilli, obelisco suo dedita opera confixerit; frustrà recitârim; præ manibus liber est: Ecce Inquisitores conscios sibi, & erroris & fraudis: Quibus occinam ego merito, quod Arrianis quondam Ambrosius; Literas quidem abolere potuistis, sed fidem non potuistis auferre: Plus vos illa litura prodebat, plus vos illa litura damnabat.In Rom.8. Chrys.hom.de verbis Pauli, Non solum sed gloriamur in afflict. Tom.3. p.945. In epist.ad Tit. c.2. Hier.in ep. ad Rom.c.10.Fides sola iustificat; deleatur: ad Gal.2. Cyr.in Ef.l.4. Orat.5. Habitat Iesus per fidem in cordibus nostris.
Sed conciliari hæc forsan quidam autumant, meram verborum litem; Etenim quæ Pontificijs inhærens iustitia est, ipsa sanctificatio est Euangeli-Ambr.de Spir. Sa.l.3.c.11.

page.notes: Marginal notes right side are transcribed as printed. Bottom "cis ;" is a partial catchword-like fragment of the next word, left as printed. The left column's final line continues onto the next page.
